description: Explicit, reviewable match rules connecting normalized 2024 jurisdiction equipment context to equipment dossiers. Product-family matches and manufacturer-only context are intentionally separate evidence scopes.

sourcePolicy.caveat: These jurisdiction rows are third-party administration context. A product-family name supports only that named family at the reported jurisdiction grain. A manufacturer match does not establish that a particular dossier model, component, firmware version, or certified configuration was deployed.
